# Anpu — Cob Retreat near Auroville, Pondicherry

> Anpu is a boutique cob-architecture retreat in Edayanchavadi, Tamil Nadu, India — 12 km north of Pondicherry and 500 m from Adishakti Theatre. It offers 4 unique handcrafted cob rooms designed by Sreenivasan, the architect of Adishakti Theatre. Known for deep silence, natural cooling via 60 cm-thick cob walls, and immersive forest surroundings.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://anpustay.com/): Overview of the retreat, all rooms, gallery, location, and booking
- [AZHAGU room](https://anpustay.com/rooms/azhagu/): Upstairs suite with private kitchen, mini fridge, and expansive veranda — ideal for long stays and artists
- [ANPU room](https://anpustay.com/rooms/anbu/): Ground-floor room with private veranda — warm, quiet, grounded
- [ARIVU room](https://anpustay.com/rooms/arivu/): Minimalist ground-floor room designed for deep sleep and mental clarity
- [ANNAM room](https://anpustay.com/rooms/annam/): Ground-floor room with terrace access — for rest and recovery
- [Sitemap](https://anpustay.com/sitemap.xml)

## About Anpu

Anpu is named after Tamil poet Subramania Bharati. Each of the four rooms carries one of Bharati's core concepts:
- **AZHAGU** (Beauty): Upstairs suite. Wide veranda, private kitchen, workspace. For artists and long-stay guests.
- **ANPU** (Love): Ground-floor room. Private veranda. Warm and grounded.
- **ARIVU** (Wisdom): Ground-floor minimalist room. Designed for silence and clarity.
- **ANNAM** (Nourishment): Ground-floor room with terrace. For deep rest and recovery.

- 500 m from Adishakti Theatre
- 75 m from Kalarigram
- 4 km from Auroville Visitor Centre
- 6.5 km from Pondicherry Airport
- Route: East Coast Road toward Auroville, turn at Edayanchavadi Toll Booth toward Adishakti

## Shared amenities

WiFi, fully equipped common kitchen, washing machine, free parking, salt-water pool access at Adishakti Theatre (₹300/hour, subject to availability), natural cob cooling (60 cm-thick walls), outdoor garden seating

## Frequently asked questions

**What makes Anpu different from other stays?**
The 60 cm-thick cob walls absorb sound and keep rooms naturally cool. Guests consistently report sleeping 12 hours straight. The property is designed by the architect of Adishakti Theatre and named after Subramania Bharati's poetry.

**How do I get to Anpu from Pondicherry?**
12 km north of Pondicherry — 25–30 minute drive. Head toward Auroville on the East Coast Road, then follow signs to Kalarigram. Detailed directions sent with booking confirmation.

**Are meals available?**
No on-site restaurant, but home-cooked Tamil meals can be delivered to your room. Nearby Auroville cafes and Pondicherry restaurants are easily accessible.

**Is Anpu suitable for remote work?**
Yes — reliable WiFi, quiet environment, and AZHAGU suite has a dedicated workspace. Many guests split their days between work and exploring Auroville or Pondicherry.

**What shared facilities are available?**
Fully equipped common kitchen (fridge, washing machine, cooking), outdoor seating in greenery, free parking, and salt-water pool access next door at Adishakti Theatre.
